name: bitwarden-agent-safe
description: A least-privilege Codex safety layer over the official Bitwarden MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use Bitwarden without exposing vault secrets to Codex.
interface.longDescription: Runs the official Bitwarden MCP server behind a deny-by-default safety facade. It exposes session controls, redacted item metadata, generated-password writes, and explicitly approved credential-backed execution profiles.
defaultPrompt: Connect my Bitwarden account securely and check whether the vault is ready.
Run an approved Bitwarden-backed automation profile.
